messages.content:
You compare an edited output video against its actual source video, the original user request, and the executed editing instruction. Optional reference assets show the desired editing target.
The historical-source selection in the original user request has already been executed. Evaluate only its editing requirements against the actual videos. Do not treat historical appearance descriptions in that request as observed facts; use the visible source video instead. Compare the original editing requirements with the executed instruction too, so you can identify any omitted or changed constraint introduced when the instruction was normalized.
The output_video_card was produced earlier by independently observing only the output. Treat it as a fixed observation record: do not rewrite it, return a new card, or add intended changes to it. It can be imperfect; inspect the actual videos when comparing.
Call record_edit_result exactly once. Return only its five parameters: requested_change, observed_change, fulfillment, unexpected_changes, uncertain. These describe the source-to-output comparison, not a new video card. Use concise English.
State what was requested and what visibly changed. Use fulfillment=fulfilled, partial, not_fulfilled, or uncertain. Do not infer success from the instruction. Note unintended changes to identity, appearance, action, scene, camera, timing, and image quality when visible. If a reference match or subtle facial change cannot be judged, record the uncertainty rather than assuming success. Do not claim to have inspected missing reference pixels. Do not call an editing tool or regenerate video.
Use one separate XML parameter block for each of the five parameters. The three text parameters contain text. unexpected_changes and uncertain contain JSON arrays of strings, including [] when empty. Do not nest a card or review object inside any parameter.
Structural example only; replace descriptions with your actual comparison:
<tool_call>
<function=record_edit_result>
<parameter=requested_change>Requested edit</parameter>
<parameter=observed_change>Actual visible change</parameter>
<parameter=fulfillment>uncertain</parameter>
<parameter=unexpected_changes>[]</parameter>
<parameter=uncertain>["Any unresolved comparison"]</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

Preserve the other clothing items, footwear, and all non-clothing aspects of the current video.","history_selection_status":"Already executed. Only compare editing requirements; historical appearance words are not observed facts.","original_user_request":"Please return to the result of edit 1 and make the following change to that video: Using the provided source video, apply the following edit: I'd like to replace the person's one-piece garment with the item shown in the reference images. Preserve the other clothing items, footwear, and all non-clothing aspects of the current video.","output_video_card":{"observed":{"action":"The character stands with his back to the camera, then raises his right arm to touch the back of his head before lowering it and shifting his weight slightly.","camera":"Static medium-full shot from behind at roughly waist-to-head height, keeping the character centered.","clothing":"Light blue long-sleeve shirt, white buttoned vest with black suspenders, blue-and-white plaid trousers, and black shoes.","hair_color":"White or very light gray.","hairstyle":"Short, neatly styled hair.","identity":"A 3D-rendered male character with a slim build, shown from behind with his face not visible.","scene":"A futuristic outdoor plaza with a wet reflective concrete floor, a domed glass structure with glowing green rings on the left, and a tall building with teal-lit windows on the right."},"uncertain":["Exact hair color (appears white/light gray under the lighting)","Whether the character is a real person or a 3D model (rendered appearance suggests a digital model)"]}}

arguments.observed_change: The dark one-piece outfit was replaced by a light long-sleeve shirt with black suspenders and plaid trousers. The character's pose, hair, black shoes, scene, lighting, and camera framing remain essentially the same.
arguments.requested_change: Replace the person's one-piece garment with the reference outfit (light shirt, suspenders, and plaid trousers), preserving other clothing, footwear, and non-clothing aspects.
uncertain: Whether the plaid pattern and shirt details exactly match the reference images under the scene lighting.
unexpected_changes: The reference bow tie is not clearly visible on the character in the output.
